summary.text: Scott Bendett is a Republican member of the New York State Assembly who has represented District 107 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on the Republican and Conservative Party lines in the November 3, 2026 general election; he is a business owner and former Rensselaer County legislator.

paragraphs.text: Bendett lives in Averill Park, New York, and his career experience includes owning several businesses, Habana Premium Cigar Shoppe and Bendett Investment Group.
He served as a Rensselaer County legislator, became president of the Averill Park Education Foundation and joined the town of Sand Lake's Zoning Board of Appeals.
Bendett assumed office on January 1, 2023, succeeding Jacob Ashby.
Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignments as Aging, Insurance, Racing and Wagering, Small Business, and Transportation.
